items.text: Players out for Sunday include ... Breece Hall ...
items.implication: Braelon Allen inherits lead role as low-end RB2 vs CHI.
items.opportunity: Allen early-down/goal-line/two-minute snaps; Wilson concentrated targets.

items.text: Nico Collins is good to go.
items.why: Returned to practice; Grade 1 hamstring; Friday report clear.
items.implication: Stroud efficiency jumps (higher Comp%/TD rates with Collins); full WR1 usage.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone looks restored vs DAL.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; did not practice this week.
items.implication: Hurts QB value dips outside top-12; Wicks elevated as high-end WR3.
items.opportunity: Dontayvion Wicks and Makai Lemon see expanded routes/targets; Goedert also out concentrates further.

items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.why: Cleared after prior absence; Donald separate back issue.
items.implication: Nacua resumes WR1 role; Adams/Higbee lose some shine but remain viable.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route share return for Nacua vs PHI.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle from Week 3; missed practice all week.
items.implication: Jordan Addison becomes high-end WR3/WR2 in strong matchup vs MIA; Vikings may lean run-heavy.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Addison and secondary WRs; Aaron Jones volume boost possible.

items.text: Players out for Sunday include Jayden Daniels...
items.implication: Mariota streams as priority QB in good matchup vs IND.
items.opportunity: Mariota rush/pass volume; McLaurin/others if healthy.

items.text: Players out for Sunday include ... Jadarian Price ...
items.implication: Committee of Wilson/Holani; limited fantasy upside for SEA RBs.
items.opportunity: Emanuel Wilson early/goal-line; Holani pass downs; Charbonnet practice return long-term.

items.text: Kyle Shanahan said WR Mike Evans, who is dealing with a rib injury, will be a game-time decision.
items.why: Ribs; intends to play with padding; pain tolerance.
items.implication: If out, Kittle/Deebo/Samuel upside rises; if in, limited efficiency risk.
items.opportunity: Kittle target climb if Evans limited/out.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price through first month in NFL: 1. Lost goal-line (and some base) work to Emmanuel Wilson 2. Lost pass-down work to George Holani 3. Lost fumbles in back-to-back games 4. Is hurt (chest) 5. Zach Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. That said, Price passes eye test and has run well when given chances. Far, far, far from over for Price longer-term.
items.why: Role split + fumbles + injury + Charbonnet practice.
items.implication: Short-term fade; long-term eye-test positive once healthy.
items.opportunity: Goal-line to Wilson; pass to Holani; Charbonnet looming.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
items.why: Back managed; fully cleared injury report.
items.implication: Full dual-threat QB1 usage; Flowers/Andrews elevated.
items.opportunity: Normal snap share, rush attempts, red-zone design.

items.text: Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): Warren led all running backs with a 90% snap rate last week, handling 20 of Pittsburgh's 22 RB touches. Cleveland has allowed at least 88 yards to a running back in every game this season. Full workhorse role here with Rico Dowdle out once again.
items.why: 90% snaps, 20/22 touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows RB yards.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: RB5 in utilization score last week, with his 26 touches outpacing his Weeks 1 and 2 combined. The Giants are allowing 5.1 YPC to opposing backs (third-most), and Love's carried a double-digit target share in every game so far.
items.why: 26 touches, high utilization, NYG soft vs RBs, double-digit targets.

items.text: Only a 4-game sample. But with Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share. With Sampson healthy for most of 2025, Judkins was at 8.3%. Judkins now on pace to catch 64 passes.
items.why: Sampson absence drives elevated target share/pace.
items.implication: Judkins RB upside via receiving work; PPR boost.
items.opportunity: 13.8% target share, routes in CLE offense.

items.text: Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 in utilization score this season with just a 3.5% target share and 25% route participation. His snap rate dropped to a season-low 42% in Week 3, and he played just 13% of third-down snaps. Seattle is allowing only 2.9 YPC to running backs — second-fewest in the league.
items.why: Low utilization/targets/routes/snaps; tough SEA run D.
